name: video-editing
title_zh: 命令行剪片：切、拼、转竖屏、烧字幕一条龙
tagline_zh: 不想为一分钟的 Reel 打开 Pr 等它加载。这里 ffmpeg 负责切拼、转 9:16、压速度、混音。
tagline_en: Skip the editor launch for a one-minute Reel. ffmpeg cuts, joins, reframes to 9:16, speeds and mixes; whisper.
desc_en: Edit video from the command line with ffmpeg and whisper. Use whenever the user wants to cut/trim/join clips, turn a horizontal video into a vertical Reel/Short (9:16), generate or burn-in subtitles/auto-captions, add music, speed up, or extract audio. Triggers on "смонтируй", "нарежь", "reels", "shorts", "субтитры", "автотитры", "вертикальное видео", "склей", "обрежь", "монтаж", edit video, trim,
why_zh: 字幕不是外挂文件，是 whisper 转写后按时间轴烧进画面的像素，导出即成品，发出去不用再对一遍。
why_en: Captions aren't a sidecar file — whisper transcribes, then they're burned into the pixels on the timeline. What you export is.
limit_zh: 本机得装好 ffmpeg 和 whisper，模型首次下载要等；它只做线性剪辑，转场特效、调色、多轨合成一概不管。
limit_en: Needs ffmpeg and whisper installed locally; first model download takes a while. Linear edits only — no transitions, grading, or multitrack. Vertical.
title_en: Command-line video editing: cut, join, go vertical, burn.
